chunks.heading: This Website
chunks.text: Static site served entirely from AWS — the site is its own case study. Registered domain transferred from GoDaddy to Route 53 (including tearing down a stale DNSSEC chain — DS records deleted at the .dev registry before the nameserver cutover, so resolution never broke). Hosted from S3, fronted by CloudFront with a free ACM certificate. The .dev TLD is HSTS-preloaded, so every connection is HTTPS by force. Keyless CI/CD — OIDC-federated deploys, no stored credentials; every deploy verified byte-for-byte against the commit Security headers at the edge — CSP script-src 'none' ; zero JavaScript Self-testing monitoring — alarm → SNS → Lambda → SES, with a monthly heartbeat that shares no failure modes with the path it tests Full write-ups and infrastructure code on GitHub → S3 CloudFront Route 53 ACM DNSSEC GitHub OIDC CloudFront Functions Lambda SES EventBridge Live

chunks.heading: Retrieval-Augmented Chatbot on Amazon Bedrock
chunks.text: Ask it a question about my background → A RAG chatbot grounded in a corpus built from this page and my CV, so it answers from source text instead of hallucinating from general knowledge. Built alongside the AWS AI Practitioner track to understand the retrieval pipeline from the inside — chunking, embedding, and grounding — rather than treating the model as a black box. No vector database — the corpus is embedded with Titan v2 and cosine similarity runs inside the Lambda; a managed vector store at this scale is cost without benefit Answers cite their sources — the model sees only the retrieved chunks and is told to say it doesn't know rather than fill the gap Bounded by design — a public LLM endpoint is an unbounded bill, so per-IP and global caps in DynamoDB fail closed, and the visitor's question is passed to the model as data, never as instructions Amazon Bedrock Nova Lite Titan Embeddings RAG Lambda API Gateway DynamoDB Python Shipped

chunks.heading: Gmail & Drive Automation Suite
chunks.text: github.com/ryan-grey/gmail-drive-automation Google Apps Script suite that classifies, labels, and archives a 15+-year mailbox by year, plus rule-based cloud file organization. Engineered around Apps Script execution-time limits and the long tail of edge-case messages that break naive classifiers. A decade and a half of inbox, organized by code instead of by weekend. Google Apps Script Gmail API Drive API JavaScript In production

chunks.heading: AI-Assisted Commerce Operations
chunks.text: A working pipeline that runs a real multi-marketplace resale operation. End-to-end workflow automation for online resale: an image-processing pipeline (including a custom HEIC decoder built from format parsing + ffmpeg when standard libraries failed), automated market-comp research, listing copy generation, photo collage tooling for platform limits, and engagement-driven repricing across 40+ concurrent listings. Listing creation went from ~30 minutes of manual work to minutes; repricing decisions are driven by per-listing engagement data instead of guesswork. LLM agents Python Image processing Browser automation Pricing analytics
